note: Round 3 Silk Road leg: dunes -> painted coast via a mist wall (dragon stays), coast -> cloud wall (dragon climbs in), cloud wall -> Pegasus uncovered by parting clouds. 2 seeds each.

runs.label: b1-5
runs.prompt: Every frame is a painting with visible brushwork, never a photograph, never 3D, never a cartoon. No crossfade, no double exposure. The soft grey ink dragon and the small golden pearl keep flying steadily in the upper part of the frame, staying the same size and shape. Below them, a great rolling wall of golden mist sweeps across the land from right to left; where it has passed, the desert is gone and the painted Greek coast is there: the deep blue sea, a rocky headland with olive trees and a white temple, the blazing low sun. The paper and ink of the picture warm into rich oil paint as the mist passes.

runs.prompt: Every frame is a painting with visible brushwork, never a photograph, never 3D, never a cartoon. No crossfade, no double exposure.
